description: Description: A recording of a fast-flowing mountain river and continuous water stream. The sound captures the heavy liquid rush, crisp water splashes against rocks, bubbling rapids, and the immersive low-end resonance of a strong natural current. This sound is suitable for nature ambiances, mountain landscapes, riverbanks, Foley work, games, films, and outdoor background sound design. Technical details: Recorder: Zoom H5 Microphone: XYH-5 Audio file types: WAV Sample rate: 96kHz Bit depth: 24bit Loop: Yes Additional: Stereo If any of these sounds have been of help, and you are feeling charitable, please do consider donating to Freesound.org to help keep the site running.
